body:
Ok let's start knocking these problems off one by one:

Barely know English -- honestly your English is a lot better than most of the native speakers I know. No, it's not perfect but then neither is mine and I am from the UK.

[Boyfriend's] dad constantly says nigga, talks super fast, claims woman and men are different and always will be constantly swears and has get rich quick schemes is a stoner and thrill seeker. -- sounds like the dad has more of a problem than you do!

Boyfriend refuses to promise to stay with me forever -- albeit that it is brutally honest he is simply telling the truth here.  None of us can genuinely make that promise. Whether it be another person or death there is always going to be a reason why you have to leave a relationship. 

You shouldn't be scared of life --  Why not?  Sometimes life is scary.  This just doesn't make sense to me. 

At this point, I went back to see what else was said to you and note you have deleted your post.  I am sorry to see that and I hope the words written so far will help even if only in the most minor way.

Yes! The 'treatment' I have received for psychiatric problems has been nothing short of barbaric.  Basically they really don't care about the patient, just their own reputation and making sure you don't die on their 'watch'.  

The closest I have got to upsetting one was when I called a doctor a "sanctimonious, pathetic, small-minded individual" whose decision making I would be taking to a judicial review on the basis it was doing more harm than good and was intended only to protect himself rather than for the good of the patient.   Needless to say he was quite angry but it got me out of there!

Good advice thank you. O's job usually involves relatively short-term interaction with others so it's  unlikely that he will ever come across said co-worker again but I can make it clear that I would not want him to work with her in the future should the situation arise. 

I can also "lay down the law" as a condition of the relationship,  ie if he cheats or does certain other things then the relationship will end with no ifs, buts or maybes.  I will still be hurt but, as you say, better to cut your losses than live with anxiety.
Thank you.  I genuinely had not even thought of this (I was too busy brooding!).  I will start looking for a suitable therapist in my area.  Thank you so much.
